entities.name: Milan Matulović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milan Matulović was a Serbian-Yugoslav chess grandmaster who was the third strongest Yugoslav player for much of the 1960s and 1970s behind Svetozar Gligorić and Borislav Ivkov. He was primarily active before 1977, but remained an occasional tournament competitor until 2006.
